capabilities: Log expenses through a quick-add form with amount, description, category, and custom date/time
Visualize spending across 8 life dimensions in an interactive SVG wheel with hover inspection
Track a monthly budget with real-time total spent and remaining balance
Append transactions under headers in a designated Markdown journal note
Filter and search expense history and export it to CSV
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README covers installation, commands, and settings but has no screenshots or troubleshooting.
motivation: The author built it around the Wheel of Life personal development framework so money is organized across 8 dimensions of human flourishing rather than tracked as dry, isolated numbers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in expense tracking, and plain number-based ledgers don't show how spending maps to life areas.
summary: Expense tracker that logs spending, visualizes it in an interactive 8-dimension Wheel of Life SVG chart, and syncs transactions to a Markdown journal note.
